events.title: Between 1926 and 1938 · the Benson house at the end of Algelo Avenue
events.summary: A family photograph looking at the house at the end of Algelo Avenue, with the seawall in front of it, Side Beach, Back Beach and a great many trees. Ivar and Greta Benson bought the house on the island in 1926. The front of the house was damaged and changed in the 1938 hurricane, so the picture dates from between those two years. The year the seawall was built is not known; the family holds earlier pictures taken before it was there. The registry agrees on the purchase: a deed recorded September 7, 1926 (Book 1516, Page 128) conveys 47 Algelo Avenue from State Realty Corporation to Ivar P. Benson.
events.dateOriginal: 1926–1938 (bracketed by the purchase and the 1938 hurricane)
events.dateNote: Bracketed date only. The timeline places it midway (1932) so it sorts between the purchase and the hurricane; the exact year is unknown.
notes: Shared by the Bensons' grandson, Sean P. Sullivan, in the Quasuet Island/Hamilton Beach Friends and Family group on July 9, 2023. Transcribed from a screenshot of the post supplied by a resident; the post itself is behind a Facebook sign-in and is not linked here.
See the deed record of September 7, 1926 (1516/128) in this timeline for the purchase itself.
quotations: “This is looking at my grandparents' house at the end of Algelo Ave. along with Side Beach, Back Beach, and a whole lot of trees… my grandparents Ivar and Greta Benson bought the house on the island in 1926.” — Sean P. Sullivan, July 9, 2023

sources.label: Sean P. Sullivan, Quasuet Island/Hamilton Beach Friends and Family (Facebook group), July 9, 2023 — screenshot held by the association

events.review: Photograph and post read from a resident's screenshot; the 1926 purchase matches deed 1516/128 in this chronology
events.caveat: A family photograph with a bracketed date. The 1926 purchase is confirmed by the recorded deed; the seawall year and the 1938 storm damage rest on the family's account.
